evidence.reason: The denylist workflow’s secret scan can be bypassed: a PR can add `.gitattributes` marking a file as non-diffable, causing `git log -p` to emit only a binary summary; gitleaks 8.30.1 does not scan such non-archive binary diffs. That violates the current contract’s blocking/fail-closed denylist requirement. The same exposure exists at the octopus scan’s `--log-opts`. Adding `--text` to both gitleaks git `--log-opts` values is the smallest compatible fix and does not require owner judgment.
